messages:
Alex Chen: Hey infra — trying to spin up a short pilot in asia-east1 for customer 'Skyline'. Need to provision A100 80GB x8 and L4 x12 for inference snapshots. Current quotas show A100=0, L4=2 in redwood-pilot-asia. Can we raise to A100:8 and L4:32? Also need ~50 external NAT IPs (ephemeral EIP-equivalents) for the pilot. CC @Tess Miller @Ravi Patel

Tess Miller: Thanks. Two quick asks: (1) which billing account should these costs be charged to? (2) is the project attached to a shared VPC host project or using its own VPC? That changes how we request quotas.

Alex Chen: Project ID: redwood-pilot-asia. Billing host: billing-pilot-cust (split billing — customer will cover infra). Project is currently in a host project but not attached to shared VPC yet (we wanted dedicated networking).

Ravi Patel: Need to file a GCP quota request form. A couple of blockers we should call out in the justification: regional availability for A100 in asia-east1 is tight right now, and quota increases over a certain threshold require org-level approval. Also NAT/external-ip capacity requests often need traffic profile + reason. Can you paste a short traffic profile and justification?

Maria Gomez: Quick finance note — roughly estimating costs (on-demand) for pilot: A100-80GB ~ $32/hr * 8 * 24 * 30 ~ ~$184k/mo; L4 ~ $0.50/hr * 12 * 24 * 30 ~ ~$4.3k/mo. We should consider preemptible/spot for lower cost or reserved commit. Do you have expected concurrency & hours?

Alex Chen: We're forecasting 40 qps peak with batching, ~12h/day sustained for first month; willing to try spot for L4, but A100 needs stability. If we convert to reserved for A100 for 1-month trial maybe cheaper. For NAT: ~1TB/day egress, mostly to customer endpoints.

Tess Miller: Good. Alex — please include that traffic profile in the quota request justification. Also please confirm the billing owner (Maria) approves charging to billing-pilot-cust.

Alex Chen: Got it — justification attached in form. Maria ok to charge.

Tess Miller: Here's a snippet you can paste into the GCP support quota form (accelerator section):

```
{"project": "redwood-pilot-asia",
 "region": "asia-east1",
 "accelerators": [
   {"type": "A100-80GB", "current_quota": 0, "requested_quota": 8, "justification": "Customer Skyline pilot: low-latency inference, 40 qps peak, 12h/day. Regional availability limited; will reserve for trial."},
   {"type": "L4", "current_quota": 2, "requested_quota": 32, "justification": "Batching workers for pre/post processing; spot ok."}
 ],
 "network": {"external_ips": 50, "egress_profile": "~1TB/day to customer endpoints, mostly TLS"},
 "billing_account": "billing-pilot-cust"
}
```

Ravi Patel: Filed support ticket: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/123456789012345 (Request ID: 123456789012345). I included the justification and the split-billing note. @Maria please confirm budget approval on the ticket comments. @Aaron (oncall) — please sanity-check network implications (shared VPC / NAT).

Aaron (oncall): Quick oncall note — we have an existing peer for that customer via host project. Allocating 50 external IPs could complicate routes & NAT. Suggest using Cloud NAT with a smaller pool and 1:1 mapping or use Private Service Connect for customer callbacks. Also confirm no overlapping IP ranges.

Tess Miller: Good catch. Alex — can you confirm IP ranges and whether Private Service Connect could be used instead of many EIPs?

Alex Chen: We can try Private Service Connect for callbacks, but customer requires inbound connections from known IPs (whitelist on their firewall). We'll keep 50 external IPs as a request but note PSC as fallback. IP ranges do not overlap.

InfraBot: [automated] Support case 123456789012345 updated: Quota request received. Preliminary review: L4 request looks OK; A100 request requires regional capacity check and org approval. Network request forwarded to Networking team.

Ravi Patel: For approvals — Maria (finance) needs to add a comment approving charge to billing-pilot-cust, and Security should sign off on the NAT plan. I put a tentative estimate in the ticket to speed approval.

Maria Gomez: Commented on the ticket: finance approves charging pilot to billing-pilot-cust up to $100k for first 30 days; any overage to be flagged and approved. :white_check_mark:

InfraBot: [automated] Support case 123456789012345 status: PARTIAL_APPROVAL. L4 quota increased to 32. A100 approved to 6 (temporary). Network external IPs pending. Ticket updated by GCP at 2278910330.

Alex Chen: Thanks — partial approval helps. Can infra allocate A100x6 and spin L4 workers while we wait on full A100? Please keep me posted on the external IP decision.

Tess Miller: Will do — I'll coordinate with Networking to get the NAT plan approved. If they require fewer EIPs we'll adjust PSC + NAT and update customer.

Alex Chen: Great, thanks everyone.
